transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. Before we begin, can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I’d barely gotten settled in my new apartment, and then suddenly I was saying yes to mentoring sessions, extra client prototypes, and completely redesigning my portfolio. It felt like I had to fix my whole life in one sprint.
How long has this burst of high energy and taking on all these new commitments been going on for?
Since I moved into the apartment, so about a month now. It’s been this intense up-and-down pattern the whole time.
During this past month, have you noticed that you need much less sleep than usual but still feel energetic the next day?
Yes. There were several nights where I only slept maybe three or four hours, but I woke up feeling completely fine—like I should just use the extra time to get ahead.

Before this past month, would you say you’ve had similar swings between very high energy/impulsivity and low, unstable moods on and off for years, or is this kind of intense, non-stop drive completely new and different from how you normally are?
I’m not really sure. I know this past month has felt unusually intense, but I can’t say for certain how it compares to other times.

During this past month, has this high energy and drive caused serious problems—like conflicts at work, financial trouble, or needing to be hospitalized—or has it mostly just felt like an intense but manageable burst of productivity?

Mostly it’s been the money. I bought expensive light fixtures, design software add-ons, and then a last-minute flight for a trip I really couldn’t afford. I didn’t realize how much I’d spent until afterward, and it hit my savings pretty badly.
Have you ever had a period, at any time in your life, lasting two weeks or more, where you felt persistently sad, low on energy, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
Yes. The heavier low periods have been coming and going since my separation, about 11 months ago. They’ve lasted more than a couple of weeks at a time, and this latest move has made it feel sharper.

During this past month, would you say the high energy, reduced need for sleep, and impulsive spending were continuously present for at least a full week at a time, or did they come and go in shorter bursts?
It’s been this whole up-and-down pattern since I moved into the apartment, so about a month now.

Focusing just on the high-energy, high-drive symptoms you described, were there at least seven days in a row when you felt that way continuously, without dipping back into a low or depressed mood in between?
It hasn’t been seven straight days of just the high energy. It’s been more of an intense up-and-down pattern since I moved into the apartment, about a month ago.

Before this past month, had you noticed this kind of up-and-down pattern between high energy and low mood happening on and off for two years or more, or is this the first time you've experienced anything like this?
I’m not really sure how far back it goes. I know it’s been happening this past month, but I can’t say whether it was on and off for two years before that.

During the times you noticed the high energy, reduced need for sleep, and impulsive spending, did you also feel sad, hopeless, or low at the very same time, rather than these feelings happening at separate periods?

Yeah, sometimes it’s at the same time. Lately I wake up with this heavy, gray feeling in my chest, and even if everything’s quiet and nothing’s wrong, I feel like I could cry over something small, like a coffee mug in the sink.
